title: Megurine Luka — Gentle Wake-Up Call〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I have those costumes, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, you brought so many! Thank you, Luka☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Look at all the pretty white clothes☆
Oh, this dress is really cute!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Our next show takes place in a world of clouds, so I felt that white costumes were the best way to go.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Especially with how frilly and fluffy they are!
That makes them feel so floaty too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, yeah! We could even put wings on them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It'd be hard to live in the sky without wings, for sure.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: Okay, it's finished!
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What do you think of our background standee, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, it's so big.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! You two painted it all blue?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. We put in a huge effort!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We used cloth backdrops for the last show we did set atop the clouds, but this drawing is lovely.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We wanted to make the sky really pretty, so we tried painting it a bunch of different ways.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It looks amazing♪
And it will go so well with our white costumes!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's wonderful to hear!
Are you okay with this, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Where's KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
He was nearby just a second ago...
Oh, he's sitting over there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't look very happy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Oh...!
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I was just thinking about something...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What is it that's bothering you?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, it's about our props.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've been thinking about how we're going to represent the clouds onstage, and I still haven't come up with a solution.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The clouds, huh... Do we want to make standees for those too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Or what if we did the same thing as that other time? With all the smokey smoke?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I thought about that as well.
Standees would seem too rigid, and it'd be difficult to achieve the right effect with just smoke.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Right.
They need to look fluffy, since it's supposed to be a peaceful and happy world.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Exactly. I wish I could come up with a better idea...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Fluffy... Fluffy...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I know.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ooh, what?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What if we used some fluffy, white cushions?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They might look like real clouds if we made a whole lot and covered the stage with them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, that's a great idea☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that might just do the trick.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Would it also be good to have a variety of sizes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Some that are big enough to hug, and some you could rest your head on.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. Having a variety could help the stage look more mystical.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And we'll need to make them just the right softness. Not too hard, but also not too soft.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'd say fluffy in a way that they wrap themselves around you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, fluffy.
They'd definitely be like real clouds like that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Luka☆
You just keep coming up with all these great ideas!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because they're such important props.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Clouds that are soft, fluffy and wrap themselves around you could almost be used as pillows.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Pillows...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I remember us talking a little while back about gathering up some fluffy fabric in order to turn into cloud-like pillows...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Along with how we could use them during a show and when we sleep.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. That's why we should take this opportunity to make as many as we can.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. I had a feeling.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was wondering why you were coming up with all these ideas to make them comfortable...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But with this concrete an image in mind, they should turn out well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, does that mean you'll make them?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. But they're props, so please try not to use them too much as pillows, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course. I'll be looking forward to seeing how they turn out.
